description: Installation of replacement plant to the rear of the site, replacement ventilation louvres and minor changes to the shopfront
decision_conditions:
The Development hereby permitted shall only be carried out and completed strictly in accordance with the submitted plans hereby approved and any subsequent approval of details.


REASON: To ensure that the development hereby permitted is carried out in full accordance with the plans hereby approved.

The development hereby permitted must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this permission.


REASON: In order to comply with the provisions of the Town and Country Planning Act 1990 (as amended).

<div>Upon occupation, a post installation noise assessment shall be carried out to confirm compliance with the noise criteria, confirming the noise level from all plant and ancillary equipment shall not increase the<div>existing background noise level (10dB below) when measured 1m external from the nearest residential or noise sensitive premises The scheme shall be implemented in accordance with the approved details and attenuation measures, and they shall be permanently retained and maintained in working order for the duration of the use and their operation.&nbsp;</div></div><div><br></div><div>REASON: To protect the amenities of adjoining occupiers and the surrounding area</div><p><span class="im" style="color: inherit;"></span></p><div><br style="color: rgb(34, 34, 34); font-family: Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif; font-size: small; font-style: normal; font-variant-ligatures: normal; font-variant-caps: normal; font-weight: 400; letter-spacing: normal; orphans: 2; text-align: start; text-indent: 0px; text-transform: none; widows: 2; word-spacing: 0px; -webkit-text-stroke-width: 0px; white-space: normal; background-color: rgb(255, 255, 255); text-decoration-thickness: initial; text-decoration-style: initial; text-decoration-color: initial;"></div>
